newsitem.title: USA: Dow re-tests highs, NYSE re-imposes curbs.
newsitem.headline: Dow re-tests highs, NYSE re-imposes curbs.

text.p: Wall Street stocks pressed higher in choppy late afternoon activity on Tuesday, triggering program trading curbs for a second time.
The Dow industrials re-tested their day's highs, reaching 8173, up 52 points for the session, prompting the NYSE to re-impose index-arbitrage curbs at 1534 EDT/1934 GMT.
"There continues to be buying interest in the big names, with lots of volatility," said Scott Bleier, chief investment strategist at Prime Charter Ltd.
The strong bond market remained the dominant theme, with the 30-year U.S. Treasury up 11/32 to yield 6.38 percent.
